guard: the shipped topology detector accepts only the fixed manual exclusion and refuses unsupported topology
why: Every child drives the actual shipped detector CLI with real committed workflow and registry blobs. No copied parser or replaced verdict. Existing six index controls still run first.

Two original-rule mutations discriminate the fixed exclusion and fail-closed unsupported conditions. Both require the same entire smoke command after restoration. No execution performed by source author.

The unsupported-condition mutant admits true only, leaving the built-in false-condition refusal control intact. A blanket condition bypass would abort on that older control and would not discriminate this regression.

mutations.name: topology reader again refuses the fixed manual exclusion
mutations.expectRed: the shipped detector accepts only the fixed manual exclusion on an unchanged ordinary topology
mutations.cell: the shipped detector accepts only the fixed manual exclusion on an unchanged ordinary topology

mutations.name: topology reader accepts an unconditional true smoke job condition
mutations.find: if (jobConditions.some((line) => line !== "    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}")) return null;
mutations.replace: if (jobConditions.some((line) => line !== "    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}" && line !== "    if: ${{ true }}")) return null;
mutations.expectRed: the shipped detector refuses unsupported smoke job conditions instead of inventing topology
mutations.cell: the shipped detector refuses unsupported smoke job conditions instead of inventing topology
